label: Fleet Operational Intelligence for Google Cloud SQL

branding.tagline: Real-time and 14-day historical database observability, buffer cache hit ratios, connection concurrency, and query diagnostics for Google Cloud SQL (MySQL & PostgreSQL).

MYSQL_CONNECTION_NAME.label: Cloud SQL MySQL Connection Name
MYSQL_CONNECTION_NAME.description: The Looker database connection name configured for your Cloud SQL for MySQL instance (leave default or empty if only deploying PostgreSQL).

POSTGRES_CONNECTION_NAME.label: Cloud SQL PostgreSQL Connection Name
POSTGRES_CONNECTION_NAME.description: The Looker database connection name configured for your Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL instance (leave default or empty if only deploying MySQL).

POSTGRES_EXTENSION_SCHEMA.label: PostgreSQL Extension Schema Name
POSTGRES_EXTENSION_SCHEMA.description: The schema where pg_stat_statements is installed in your PostgreSQL instance (default: public).

SQL_ENGINE_TYPE.label: Primary SQL Engine Type
SQL_ENGINE_TYPE.description: Default database engine filter for unified dashboards ('mysql' or 'postgresql').
